text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak reviews with Arab parliamentarians obstacles on the way of peace and stresses the importance of creating a common Arab market. Mubarak delivers a speech today at the opening session of the seventh conference of the Arab Parliamentary Federation.

- Mubarak to co-chairm with Moroccan King Hassan II meetings of the joint committee in Rabat tomorrow. The committee will discuss cutting custom tariffs and increasing trade exchange. Mubarak leaves for Morocco today.

- Mubarak tells UAE television in an interview that it was unacceptable for any party in the Middle East to hint at the use of force. Information Minister Safwat el-Sherif says that Mubarak also discussed his opinion on inviting Iraq to future Arab summits.
- The information minister says the cabinet approves the allocation of 635,000 feddans (257,000 acres) in the southern area of Toshka to private investors.
- Mubarak orders two planes with aid to Iran. The aid includes food stuffs and medical supplies.
